episodes.synopsis: Ichigo has a date with the most popular guy at school and couldn't be happier! Little does she know that her life is about to get a lot more complicated.
episodes.title: Wait, What?! I’m a Superhero Now?! Meow!

episodes.synopsis: Tracking down the other magical girls feels like herding cats, but Ichigo is determined to find them! Will working at Café Mew Mew help her sniff out her allies?
episodes.title: What Makes a Real Friend?

episodes.synopsis: A much-anticipated outing with Aoyama takes a turn for the dangerous when a mysterious new enemy boldly introduces himself to Ichigo.
episodes.title: A Stolen Kiss?! Mew Pudding is Here!

episodes.synopsis: The Mew Mews found a new member, but getting close to her is no easy feat. They'll need to audition for a musical if they want to get anywhere near the intimidating Zakuro!
episodes.title: Who Doesn't Want to Be Her? Our Last Member is a Huge Star!

episodes.synopsis: Mint is used to getting what she wants, so when a person she respects rejects her offer, she feels a little blue. Fortunately, she has Ichigo and the others to cheer her up!
episodes.title: Smile, Mint! A Fancy Lady, Forlorn

episodes.synopsis: Mint is determined to protect Zakuro from Kish, but with the team still missing its final member, keeping the fight away from Zakuro may be a losing battle!
episodes.title: Hear My Voice! I Will Surpass Myself

episodes.synopsis: New players join the game, but are they better or worse than the impish Kish? Meanwhile, news of the Mew Mews has spread, and keeping secrets has never been tougher for them!
episodes.title: Farewell Cherry Blossom

episodes.synopsis: Lettuce is convinced that the only thing she’s good at is being bad at everything! But a soiree on the high seas may provide Lettuce the opportunity to prove herself wrong.
episodes.title: Believe In Yourself - Romance on the High Seas

episodes.synopsis: Mew Aqua can turn the tide of battle against the Chimera Anima, but finding it won't be easy. What else isn't easy to find? Spare time to spend with Aoyama, in Ichigo’s case!
episodes.title: Let Cupid's Arrow Fly! The Super Secret Date Scheme!

episodes.synopsis: A dangerous situation of epic proportions threatens thousands of civilians, but where the heck is Ichigo!? It's a race against time to find her and wipe out the alien threat!
episodes.title: Cat Got My Tongue?! A Heart-Pounding Transformation!

episodes.synopsis: Aliens have invaded, but Ichigo is nowhere to be found! Her friends have faith she'll appear and lend a hand, but will she come to their aid in time?
episodes.title: Everyone's Waiting For You! Run, Ichigo!

episodes.synopsis: The fate of the world (and Ichigo's love life) depends on her finding precious Mew Aqua so she can clear both the air of Tokyo and the air between herself and Aoyama!
episodes.title: Rain & Tears
